messages:
alex (Docs): Quick ping 11: opened a small PR to clarify purge vs deletion language on the audit-logs page and add a short SDK export + purge example. Need legal + security check. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5124
priya (Security): Thanks. Core ask: public copy should state that deletions are subject to backup cycles and legal holds. Avoid 'tenant' in public copy.
ben (Legal): Draft suggestion: "Redwood retains audit logs per the customer's retention policy. Export and deletion requests will be fulfilled where possible; requests may be delayed by lawful holds or backup retention cycles."
alex (Docs): That reads nice. I'll swap 'fulfilled' -> 'processed' in internal docs only? Public copy keep 'fulfilled' per legal. Also switching TTL examples to ISO durations.
tara (DevEx): I'll add a compact Python SDK snippet showing export + purge request and mention `redact=true` flag. Short sample:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=TOKEN)
# export
for page in client.audit.export(since='2026-06-01', format='jsonl', page_size=100):
    print(page)
# purge request (subject to holds/backups)
client.audit.purge(before='2025-01-01')
```
priya (Security): Add a one-line caveat under the snippet: "Note: purge requests do not guarantee immediate removal from backups or archives; contact support for retention exceptions."
ben (Legal): Approved wording. Alex, add me as reviewer and replace 'tenant' -> 'customer' across the doc.
alex (Docs): Done. Pushed changes and flagged PR for review. Will merge after CI and one security sign-off. Thanks all :ok_hand:
